description: This file defines the CacheManager class responsible for managing a cache of file hashes for code indexing within a VS Code extension. It includes methods for initializing, saving, clearing, and updating the cache, as well as handling errors and telemetry.

classes.name: CacheManager
classes.description: Manages the cache for code indexing, including loading, saving, clearing, and updating file hashes, with error handling and telemetry integration.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a new CacheManager with extension context and workspace path, setting up cache path and debounce function.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Loads the cache data from disk and handles errors with telemetry.

methods.name: _performSave
methods.description: Saves the current file hashes to disk, with error handling and telemetry.

methods.name: clearCacheFile
methods.description: Clears the cache file by writing an empty object and resetting internal state.

methods.name: getHash
methods.description: Retrieves the hash for a specific file path.

methods.name: updateHash
methods.description: Updates the hash for a file path and triggers a debounced save.

methods.name: deleteHash
methods.description: Deletes the hash for a file path and triggers a debounced save.

methods.name: getAllHashes
methods.description: Returns a copy of all stored file hashes.
